scientific_integrity: The exact identity is derived from the Dirichlet gap density and integration-by-parts recurrences.
Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
The full text of the 2011 marginal-asymptotics paper was not accessible; historical priority remains qualified.
scientific_limitations: The formula applies to n independent uniform points on a unit circle for n>=3.
It gives a covariance, not the full joint distribution, an all-n sign theorem, or an optimal finite-n estimator.
The leading asymptotic covariance is already implied by published Dirichlet power-sum expansions and is not claimed as novel.
title: Exact finite-\(n\) area–perimeter covariance for random inscribed polygons
